ModMetaData.name: Paramedic: Don't Die Yet!
ModMetaData.author: bebranotyep
ModMetaData.description:
A field medic role you put on with the uniform.
Wear the paramedic vest together with the beret (or helmet) and your colonist goes ON DUTY: better and faster tending, safer surgery, faster rescues - and an oath. Kill or maim a human with your own hands and it will weigh on them for days.
UNIFORM - 8 red-and-white pieces on every apparel layer: shirt, pants, vest, rescue jacket, beret, helmet, thermal goggles, medicine rig. - 3 research projects in their own tab; cheap cloth early, plasteel and components late. - More pieces worn - stronger bonuses (basic / equipped / full kit), scaled by quality.
ABILITIES - Field Stabilization: stop all bleeding on a downed person for 6 hours. - "Medic! Hold your fire!": most hostile humans stop targeting you for a few hours. Attack while protected and it's perfidy. - Adrenaline Shot: a downed ally gets up for half a minute to reach cover.
AND ALSO - Medicine pocket (3, or 6 with the rig), ranks from Trainee to Legend, burnout, "couldn't save them", humanitarian goodwill, triage time in the Rescue menu. - The oath: -5 to -20 mood for killing/maiming, weaker with rank; crisis of faith after repeated violations. - Mod settings; English and Russian.
Requires Harmony. Supports Combat Extended (optional). Humans only (no alien race support). Safe to add to an existing save.
Полевой медик: роль даётся формой. Русский язык в комплекте.
